# 连续时间作为离散读法之塔 / Continuous time as a tower of discrete readings

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Each level reads the next finer one at strictly increasing times, and balance (each relatum listed once) and dissipation pass to coarser levels. At any level, with what stands not refuted to run down at each fine step, a coarsest stretch has no more falls of total standing than its starting total.
>
> 每一层是更细一层在严格递增的时刻读出；平衡（每个关系项只列出一次）与耗散由更细一层传到更粗一层。一段最粗的步在任何一层读出时，所立者在其中各细步不被否定地下降，则总水平下降的细步数不多于最粗一层段首的总水平，与层无关。

## 主张 Claim

塔（Tower）：每一层有一个网与一个流，第 n 层是第 n+1 层在严格递增的时刻 refine n 读出（web_sample、flow_sample）。最粗一层的步 s 是第 n 层的 reads n s；最粗一层是第 n 层在这些时刻读出（Tower.web_zero、Tower.level_zero），这些时刻严格递增（Tower.reads_strict）。每一层的规律：每个关系项只列出一次的平衡与耗散传到更粗一层（Tower.balances_coarser、Tower.dissipative_coarser）。分得再细，变化也有界：最粗一层从 S 起 N 步的一段在第 n 层读出，第 n 层有所立者的普查、所立者在其中各细步不被否定地下降时，总水平下降的细步（即有水平改变的步）不多于最粗一层在 S 的总水平（Tower.changes_within），界与 n 无关。 / A tower (Tower): at each level a web and a flow, level n being level n+1 read at the strictly increasing times refine n (web_sample, flow_sample). Step s of the coarsest level is step reads n s of level n; the coarsest level is level n read at those times (Tower.web_zero, Tower.level_zero), which are strictly increasing (Tower.reads_strict). Laws at every level: balance with each relatum listed once, and dissipation, pass to the coarser level (Tower.balances_coarser, Tower.dissipative_coarser). Change bounded however finely divided: a stretch of N steps of the coarsest level from S, read at level n, under a census of what stands at level n and with what stands not refuted to run down at each of its fine steps, has at most as many fine steps at which the total standing falls, the steps at which some standing changes, as the coarsest level's total standing at S (Tower.changes_within); the bound does not depend on n.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 无全局前提：下降与普查只在所用的层与所用的细步上。 / No global premise: running down and the census only at the level and fine steps used.
- 表示：时间为一族离散读法，由 Sampling 的读出相连（Ren 2026-10-12 的决定）；核心不取实数。 / Representation: time as a family of discrete readings linked by the reading of Sampling (Ren's decision of 12 October); the core takes no real numbers.

Ren 2026-10-12 决定：连续时间在核心中构造为越来越细的离散读法之塔，连续时间的规律即塔的每一层上的规律，实数时间以后作为外围的对应。本结果给出塔与其第一条规律：变化不因时间分得更细而增加。依据是一步的规律（Flow.runsDown_bounds_change）与每次交换的最小损失，不加前提。 / Ren decided on 12 October that continuous time is built in the core as a tower of ever-finer discrete readings, a law of continuous time being a law at every level, real-valued time a later periphery correspondence. This result gives the tower and its first law: dividing time more finely adds no change. It rests on the laws of one step (Flow.runsDown_bounds_change) and the least loss per exchange, with no premise added.

The count uses a census; running down is a condition at the level used. The names (Tower, reads, refine) are the AI's.

- 边界：界要所立者在各细步下降。Strobe 中一个关系项在每个粗步内的细步上生起又不再活跃，而在读出时刻都安静（Strobe.converse_fails）：不加下降时，更细的一层可显示更粗的一层看不到的、无界的变化。 / Boundary: the bound needs what stands to run down at the fine steps. In Strobe a relatum arises and ceases at fine steps inside every coarse step while every sampling time is quiet (Strobe.converse_fails): without running down, a finer level can show unbounded change that a coarser one does not.
